approval_evidence.quote: 11/17/1995 ORIG-1 Approval Type 3 - New Dosage Form

series_start_reason: J&J first prints a DOXIL/CAELYX line in the 2011Q1 earnings exhibit (Form 8-K, 2011-04-19), which also prints 2010Q1. The 2011Q2, Q3 and Q4 exhibits print 2010Q2-Q4 as prior-year columns (88, 85, 67), so the series starts at 2010Q1. None of the J&J earnings 8-Ks filed 2009-01 to 2011-01 contains the line (measured), and none of the 2005-2011 10-Q/10-K documents used for sibling J&J series prints it.
series_end_reason: J&J's 2013Q1 earnings exhibit and every later earnings exhibit checked (8-K, 2013-04 to 2014-04) carry no DOXIL/CAELYX line, and the 2013Q1 Form 10-Q mentions the product only in prose ('Other Oncology increased, primarily due to DOXIL/CAELYX'): the line was folded into Other Oncology. No J&J schedule from 2015Q3 onward contains it (0 occurrences across 50 schedule PDFs, measured).
notes: Annual cross-check: J&J's FY2012 Form 10-K (ex13) prints DOXIL/CAELYX 83 (2012), 402 (2011), 320 (2010); the four quarters sum to 83 (2012: 24+13+16+30), 402 (2011: 139+138+86+39) and 320 (2010: 80+88+85+67). Scope is worldwide (US plus Intl); the US and Intl rows are printed in each exhibit. Ownership after the series: Baxter International acquired the U.S. rights in 2019 and the ex-U.S. rights from a J&J subsidiary on 2021-02-17; Baxter's Form 10-K/10-Q print only acquisition-note net sales for the ex-U.S. rights in 2021 (Q1 13 partial quarter from 2021-02-17, Q2 28, Q3 32, nine months 73, year 108) and a $20 million U.S. figure for 2019, which are not a continuous line of the same scope and are not spliced in.
search_log: Bigdata.com search 'Doxil net sales by quarter' (filings): returned only Baxter International documents describing the 2019 U.S. and 2021 ex-U.S. acquisitions of Doxil/Caelyx rights from J&J; no quarterly product line.
Downloaded 50 J&J quarterly sales schedule PDFs (2015Q3-2026Q2) and searched every page for DOXIL/CAELYX: 0 occurrences, so the line is not printed in any schedule from 2015Q3 on.

Fetched J&J 10-Q/10-K documents 2005Q1-2014Q2 (the URLs of the sibling J&J manifests) and searched for DOXIL: the product line appears in the 2012Q1-2012Q4 10-Q/10-K tables (24, 13, 16, FY 83) and only in prose in 2013Q1 and 2013Q4; nothing in 2005-2011 10-Qs.

Listed J&J Form 8-K Item 2.02 filings 2009-01 to 2014-06 via data.sec.gov submissions and searched every exhibit for DOXIL/CAELYX: present in the Exhibit 99.2 segment-sales schedule of the 2011Q1 to 2012Q4 releases (including a Q2 2011 release on accession 0000200406-11-000091), absent before and after.
Checked sums against the FY2012 10-K annual line (83/402/320); all three years reconcile exactly.
Baxter International (CIK 10456) 10-K FY2023 Note 3 and the 2021 10-Qs print acquisition-note net sales for the ex-U.S. rights (2021 only); judged a different, partial scope and not used.
